resources.string: Okokufundisa kwekhibhodi ye-SandFly
Okuthi %1$s akunaso isinqamuleli sekhibhodi. Nikeza esisodwa kokuthi Imiyalo, noma usebenzise okuthi Yeqa isinyathelo.
%1$s kabili
Isifundo siqediwe. Cindezela %1$s ukuze uqale isifundo esilandelayo.
Isifundo siqediwe. Cindezela %1$s ukuze uqede okokufundisa.
Amakhasi ewebhu

Lokhu kokufundisa kufundisa izinqamuleli zekhibhodi ze-SandFly. Iningi lazo lisebenzisa ukhiye weSandFly, %1$s, nezinye izinkinobho. %2$s U-Ctrl umisa inkulumo. Isifundo ngasinye sinikeza umyalelo, silinde uze ucindezele izinkinobho ezishiwo umyalelo, bese sinikeza olandelayo. Umyalelo uyinto yokuqala ngemva kwegama lesifundo. Okuthi Okuqukethwe kubala zonke izifundo, futhi okokufundisa kuvuleka futhi esifundweni obukuso.
Inkinobho ethi Meta yinkinobho ethi Windows, eseduze nenkinobho ethi Alt engakwesobunxele. Kumakhibhodi e-Apple, yinkinobho ethi Command, eseduze nenkinobho ethi Space.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uqale.
Okuthi Into elandelayo nokuthi Into yangaphambilini kuhamba ezintweni ezisesikrinini ngokulandelana kokufunda.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uye entweni elandelayo. Qhubeka uze ufike kokuthi %2$s.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uye entweni edlule. Buyela kokuthi %2$s.
Ukwenza kusebenze kusebenza entweni egxilisiwe.
Iya kokuthi %2$s. Cindezela %1$s ukuze ukwenze kusebenze.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze umake okuthi %2$s.
Ezinye izinto zenza okunye uma zibanjiwe. Iya kokuthi %2$s. Cindezela %1$s ukuze ukubambe.
Izilawuli zokufunda zikhetha lokho okwenziwa ukuhamba phezulu naphansi, njengokuhamba ngegama noma ngohlamvu. Okuthi Into elandelayo nokuthi Into yangaphambilini kusahamba phakathi kwezinto.
Cindezela %1$s noma %2$s ukuze ushintshe isilawuli sokufunda. Khetha okuthi %3$s.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uye egameni elilandelayo. Hamba amagama amathathu.
Shintsha isilawuli sokufunda sibe ngokuthi %2$s. Cindezela %1$s ukuze uhambe ngohlamvu olulodwa.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze weqele esihlokweni esilandelayo. Yeqela kokuthi %2$s.
I-SandFly ingafunda kusukela entweni egxilisiwe kuze kube sekugcineni kwesikrini. U-Ctrl umisa ukufunda.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze ufunde kusukela entweni egxilisiwe.
Uhlu lubonisa ezinye zezinto zalo kuphela ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ukuhamba udlule entweni yokugcina eboniswayo kuskrola uhlu.
Cindezela %1$s uze ufike kokuthi %2$s.
Ezinye izinto zinezenzo ngaphandle kokwenza kusebenze, njengokuthi Faka kungobo yomlando noma Susa kumlayezo. Imenyu yezenzo iyazibala.
Iya kumlayezo. Cindezela %1$s ukuze uvule izenzo zawo. Khetha okuthi %2$s.
Ukwenza inkambu yombhalo isebenze kukuvumela ukuthi uthayiphe kuyo.
Iya enkambwini ethi %2$s. Cindezela %1$s ukuze uqale ukuthayipha.
Susa uhlamvu lokugcina nge-Backspace.

I-Android inezinqamuleli zekhibhodi zayo ezisebenzisa inkinobho ethi Meta. Zisebenza kuso sonke isikrini. Kulesi sifundo, okokufundisa kusho ukuthi isinqamuleli ngasinye senzani esikhundleni sokusenza.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze ubuyele emuva.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uye esikrinini sasekhaya.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze ubonise izinhlelo zokusebenza zakamuva. U-Alt + Tab ushintsha phakathi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uvule izaziso.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uvule imenyu ye-SandFly. Dlula emiyalweni yayo. U-Esc uvala imenyu.
Cindezela u-Esc ukuze uvale imenyu.
Uhlu lwezinqamuleli zekhibhodi
I-SandFly ibala zonke izinqamuleli zekhibhodi kanye nemiyalo yazo.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uvule uhlu. U-Esc uyaluvala.
Cindezela u-Esc ukuze uvale uhlu.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze ukopishe umbhalo wokugcina i-SandFly ewushilo kubhodi yokunamathisela.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze usesha umbhalo esikrinini. Kulesi sifundo, okokufundisa kusho esikhundleni salokho ukuthi kwenzani.
Imodi yokubhrawuza

Kumodi yokubhrawuza, izinhlamvu ezizodwa zeqela entweni elandelayo yohlobo oluthile, njengo-H wezihloko, u-K wezixhumanisi no-B wezinkinobho. U-Shift nohlamvu weqela emuva. Imodi yokubhrawuza iyavaleka ngesikhathi uthayipha enkambwini yombhalo.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uvule imodi yokubhrawuza.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze weqele esihlokweni esilandelayo. Yeqela kokuthi %2$s.
Cindezela %1$s ukuze uvale imodi yokubhrawuza.
Ukuzijwayeza ikhibhodi
Isinqamuleli sekhibhodi ngasinye sisho izinkinobho zaso nomyalo waso esikhundleni sokuwusebenzisa. Okuthi Into elandelayo, okuthi Into yangaphambilini nokwenza kusebenze kusasebenza.
Cindezela noma yisiphi isinqamuleli sekhibhodi ukuze uzwe ukuthi senzani. Ukuze uyeke, yenza kusebenze okuthi %1$s.
Bamba u-Ctrl no-Alt ndawonye. Kokubili kungezansi kwesokunxele kwekhibhodi.
Kumakhibhodi amaningi, inkinobho ethi Faka isequlwini lezinkinobho eziyisithupha ngaphezu kwezinkinobho zemicibisholo.
Ukufaka kweNumpad yinkinobho ethi 0 yephedi yezinombolo, uma i-Num Lock ivaliwe.
Inkinobho ethi Alt iseduze nenkinobho ethi Space.
